description: This source file defines the ShoppingCartService interface for managing shopping cart operations within an e-commerce system, including retrieval, creation, validation, merging, and deletion of shopping carts, as well as creating shipping products and checking shipping requirements.

methods.name: getShoppingCart
methods.description: Retrieves the shopping cart associated with a specific customer, throws ServiceException if issues occur.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates the provided ShoppingCart object in persistent storage.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a ShoppingCart by its ID and associated MerchantStore, throws ServiceException on error.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its code within a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Obtains a ShoppingCart for a given Customer.

methods.name: createShippingProduct
methods.description: Creates a list of ShippingProduct objects from a ShoppingCart, returning null if items are virtual.

methods.name: isFreeShoppingCart
methods.description: Checks if the ShoppingCart is free of charges based on cart or items.

methods.name: populateShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Creates a ShoppingCartItem from a Product, including attributes if any.

methods.name: removeShoppingCart
methods.description: Removes the ShoppingCart, possibly from session or cache.

methods.name: mergeShoppingCarts
methods.description: Merges two ShoppingCarts for a user session into a single ShoppingCart, considering MerchantStore.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Determines if the ShoppingCart requires shipping based on its contents.
